title: Fidelity Before Structure: Verbatim Chunks Beat Lossy Artifact Extraction in Long-Conversation LLM Memory
abstract: arXiv:2601.00821v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A growing class of conversational-memory systems compresses dialogue history into structured artifacts (extracted facts, decisions, or events). The premise is that distilled structure retrieves better than raw text. We test this premise with a controlled ablation. Within one fixed retrieval--rerank--reasoning pipeline, we swap only the stored representation (LLM-extracted typed artifacts versus verbatim conversation chunks) and hold the model, retriever, reranker, and judge constant. Verbatim chunks win by 15.9 points on LoCoMo (43.9% vs. 28.0%) and by 22.0 points on LongMemEval-S (67.4% vs. 45.4%). A semantic graph does not recover the gap, and six confound controls reproduce the effect. The mechanism is lossy distillation rather than structure per se. Accuracy tracks how much source text survives in the store, and the extracted-artifact pipeline does not beat naive RAG in overall accuracy (chunks do abstain worse; see Limitations).

translated_title: 保真优先于结构：在长对话LLM记忆中，逐字片段优于有损的制品提取
translated_abstract: 越来越多的对话记忆系统将对话历史压缩为结构化的制品（提取的事实、决策或事件）。其前提假设是：经过提炼的结构比原始文本具有更好的检索效果。我们通过受控消融实验检验了这一前提。在一个固定的“检索—重排—推理”流水线中，我们仅替换存储的表示形式（LLM提取的类型化制品 vs. 逐字对话片段），而保持模型、检索器、重排器和评判器不变。结果显示，逐字片段在LoCoMo上以15.9个百分点胜出（43.9% vs. 28.0%），在LongMemEval-S上以22.0个百分点胜出（67.4% vs. 45.4%）。语义图无法弥合这一差距，且六项混杂因素对照实验均复现了该效应。其机制在于有损的蒸馏，而非结构本身。准确率与存储中保留下来的源文本量密切相关，且提取制品的流水线在总体准确率上并未超越朴素RAG（逐字片段的拒答表现更差；参见局限性部分）。
tldr: 在长对话LLM记忆系统中，直接存储逐字对话片段的检索准确率显著优于LLM提取的结构化信息，性能差距的根源是有损蒸馏而非结构本身。
en_tdlr: Verbatim conversation chunks significantly outperform LLM-extracted structured artifacts in long-conversation LLM memory, and the performance gap stems from lossy distillation rather than structure itself.
